# duploai Provider





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `duplo_host` (String) Base URL of the DuploCloud AI API (e.g. http://localhost:60021). May also be set via DUPLO_HOST or duplo_host env var.
- `duplo_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for DuploCloud API authentication. May also be set via DUPLO_TOKEN or duplo_token env var.
- `http_timeout` (Number) HTTP client timeout in seconds for DuploCloud API calls (default 60). May also be set via HTTP_TIMEOUT or http_timeout env var.
- `ssl_no_verify` (Boolean) Disable TLS certificate verification (development only). May also be set via SSL_NO_VERIFY or ssl_no_verify env var.
